mapper.sql: select b.bottling_id, b.batch_id, bt.batch_no, b.source_container_id, c.container_code as source_container_code, b.trace_code_prefix, b.trace_code_start, b.trace_code_end, (b.trace_code_end - b.trace_code_start + 1) as bottle_count, b.bottling_date, b.bottle_spec, b.cap_code, b.qr_code_url, b.remarks, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time from trace_bottling_info b left join trace_batch bt on bt.batch_id = b.batch_id left join trace_container c on c.container_id = b.source_container_id
mapper.select: where b.del_flag = '0' and b.trace_code_prefix = #{traceCodePrefix} and not (b.trace_code_end < #{traceCodeStart} or b.trace_code_start > #{traceCodeEnd}) limit 1
select count(1) from trace_bottling_info where batch_id = #{batchId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_bottling_info where source_container_id = #{containerId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_warehouse_bill_detail where bottling_id = #{bottlingId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into trace_bottling_info ( batch_id, source_container_id, trace_code_prefix, trace_code_start, trace_code_end, bottling_date, bottle_spec, cap_code, qr_code_url, remarks, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{batchId}, #{sourceContainerId}, #{traceCodePrefix}, #{traceCodeStart}, #{traceCodeEnd}, #{bottlingDate}, #{bottleSpec}, #{capCode}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
